home.tagline: Songs, visuals, archives, and noise from Stone Prism.
home.about: Stone Prism is a noise-leaning rock project built on distorted songs, collage visuals, and a fascination with decay, nature, and the in-between. DIY in spirit, rooted in texture, and always a little off-center.
